#VeriphyCCBankCheckRequestTO
VeriphyCCBankCheckRequestTO is a DTO that contains all the information required by the service to perform Bank check. It consists of 3 objects:
* VeriphyServiceTO
* AuthenticationTO
* CCBankCheckApplicationTO

##VeriphyServiceTO
You must specify the service codes in the `VeriphyServiceTO` object. Valid service codes are:
* **CCBANKACC** - Performs bank check

##AuthenticationTO
Specify your username and password to access the service. Credentials can be obtained from [Veriphy Support](mailto:support@veriphy.co.uk)

##CCBankCheckApplicationTO
The CCBankCheckApplicationTO object contains the details about the individual and account to be checked. Each request requires all the transfer objects to be supplied even if they will not be used in the check. Please supply empty string values for unused transfer objects. Refer to the Parameters section below for the request model and an example request value.

#VeriphyIDAMLRequestTO
VeriphyIDAMLRequestTO is a DTO that contains all the information required by the service to perform an identity check. It consists of 3 objects:
* VeriphyServiceTO
* AuthenticationTO
* ApplicationTO

##VeriphyServiceTO
You must specify the service code in the `VeriphyServiceTO` object. Valid service codes are:
* **IDAMLNOCRED** - Anti-money Laundering Check
* **CREDACTIVE** - Credit Screen
* **IDAML** - AML and Credit Screen
* **INTID** - International ID Check
* **HR** - HR Screen
* **DIRSEARCH** - Director search
* **ROUTE2** - Identity Check
* **360** - Veriphy 360
* **VISA** - Travel Visa Check
* **HRCREDPLUS** - HR Credit Screen Plus

A formatted PDF can also be returned by the API - simply set the `VeriphyServiceTO` *returnPDF* property to _true_ to receive the PDF as a Base64 encoded string.

##AuthenticationTO
Specify your username and password to access the service. Credentials can be obtained from [Veriphy Support](mailto:support@veriphy.co.uk)

##ApplicationTO
The ApplicationTO object contains the details about the individual to be checked. Each request requires all the transfer objects to be supplied even if they will not be used in the check. Please supply empty string values for unused transfer objects. Refer to the Parameters section below for the request model and an example request value.
* **All** `ApplicantTO` objects must contain a `NameTO`, `Gender` and `DOB`
* IDAML/IDAMLNOCRED/ROUTE2 must contain an `AddressTO` with optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO` and `DrivingLicenceTO` supported.
* CREDACTIVE must contain an `AddressTO` object. No other objects are required/supported.
* INTID supports optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO`, `DrivingLicenceTO` and `IDCardTO` objects. `AddressTO` is not required/supported on this check.
* HR must contain an `AddressTO` with optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO`, `DrivingLicenceTO` and `BankTO` supported.
* DIRSEARCH must contain an `AddressTO` object.
* 360  must contain an `AddressTO` with optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO`, `DrivingLicenceTO`, `IDCardTO`, `TravelVisaTO` and `BankTO` supported.
* VISA supports optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO`, `DrivingLicenceTO`, `IDCardTO` and `TravelVisaTO` objects. `AddressTO` is not required/supported on this check.
* HRCREDPLUS must contain an `AddressTO` object.  No other objects are required/supported.

post.description:
#VeriphyIDAMLMonitorRequestTO
VeriphyIDAMLMonitorRequestTO is a DTO that contains all the information required by the service to perform an identity check. It consists of 3 objects:
* VeriphyServiceTO
* AuthenticationTO
* ApplicationMonitorTO

##VeriphyServiceTO
You must specify the service code in the `VeriphyServiceTO` object. Valid service codes are:
* **IDAMLNOCREDMONITOR** - Anti-money Laundering Check + PEP/Sanction Monitoring

A formatted PDF can also be returned by the API - simply set the `VeriphyServiceTO` *returnPDF* property to _true_ to receive the PDF as a Base64 encoded string.

##AuthenticationTO
Specify your username and password to access the service. Credentials can be obtained from [Veriphy Support](mailto:support@veriphy.co.uk)

##ApplicationMonitorTO
The ApplicationMonitorTO object contains the details about the individual to be checked. Each request requires all the transfer objects to be supplied even if they will not be used in the check. Please supply empty string values for unused transfer objects. Refer to the Parameters section below for the request model and an example request value.
* **All** `ApplicantMonitorTO` objects must contain a `NameTO`, `Gender` and `DOB. You can also supply callback email address and/or URL for monitoring updates.
* IDAMLNOCREDMONITOR must contain an `AddressTO` with optional `ContactTO`, `NationalInsuranceNumber`, `InternationalPassportTO` and `DrivingLicenceTO` supported.
* Keep a note of the sanctionResults->content->data->id field in the response. This is required to cancel monitoring using the `Sanction/CancelMonitor` endpoint.
